name: Lead-to-Active
objective: Convert a prospect into an active client — from initial contact through needs assessment, KYC/AML verification, account opening, and first active service
criticalityReason: AML/CFT obligations require CDD before any business relationship is established. DDO target market assessment required before product issue. Consumer Duty / best interests duty apply at point of sale. Failures at this E2E create simultaneous regulatory exposure across conduct, AML, and data obligations.
farAccountability: Chief Risk Officer (conduct obligations); Chief Compliance Officer (AML/CTF programme); Head of Retail / Head of Institutional (business outcome)

name: Application-to-Drawdown
objective: Assess, approve, document, and fund a credit facility — from initial application through affordability assessment, credit decisioning, security documentation, and first drawdown
criticalityReason: Responsible lending obligations (NCCP Act / FCA MCOB) apply at assessment. DDO target market check required before issue. Basel III credit risk weights assigned at origination. IFRS 9 Stage 1 ECL recognised at drawdown. AML EDD required for high-value facilities. Failures create simultaneous exposure across conduct, prudential, and AML obligations.
farAccountability: Chief Risk Officer (credit risk framework); Chief Compliance Officer (responsible lending); Chief Credit Officer (underwriting standards)

name: Payment-to-Posted
objective: Execute, clear, settle, and post a customer payment instruction — from initiation through SCA, fraud screening, interbank clearing, and account posting
criticalityReason: PSD2/PSD3 SCA requirements apply at initiation. FATF Recommendation 16 wire transfer information requirements apply to all transfers ≥USD $1,000. AUSTRAC TTR/SMR obligations triggered by threshold transactions and suspicious activity. NPP 24/7 availability and 60-second settlement obligations. Card scheme fraud rate thresholds. A single control failure can simultaneously breach conduct, AML, and scheme rules.
farAccountability: Chief Compliance Officer (AML/CTF obligations); Chief Operating Officer (settlement and availability obligations)
